metadata.description: Hello Retail Claude Code plugins — skills that build and QA managed Hello Retail designs and feeds, skills that build custom frontends against the public REST APIs, and the Hello Retail knowledge base.

plugins.name: hello-retail
plugins.description: Hello Retail for AI agents: build and QA Search, Recommendations, Pages, newsletter and triggered-email designs as drafts, set up product feeds, and answer Hello Retail questions from the bundled knowledge base.

plugins.name: hello-retail-unmanaged
plugins.description: Hello Retail's public REST APIs for AI agents: the intricacies and edge cases of Search, Recommendations, Pages and the four tracking endpoints, so a customer's own frontend calls them correctly. The unmanaged counterpart to the hello-retail plugin — it builds no Hello Retail design and writes no configuration.
